title: Ray's Indoor Mountain Bike Park

services.name: BMX Bikes
services.desc: Rays Indoor Bike Park is proud to offer a fleet of custom Trek and Kink BMX Rentals. We take our Rental Bikes very seriously and want you to have the best experience possible while riding here at Ray’s. We take great care and expense to keep these bikes in top shape. Any rider that purposely damages our bikes will be asked to leave the park and no refund of any kind will be issued. While not required, it is always encouraged to reserve a bike, especially when visiting on weekends. This will guarantee you get the bike of your choice.
